scripts.check:text: npm run check:eof && npm run check:codeblock
scripts.optimize:media: npm run optimize:images && npm run optimize:video
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run check:media && hugo --minify --gc
scripts.vendor:katex: mkdir -p static/css/vendor/fonts static/js/vendor && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css static/css/vendor/katex.min.css && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js static/js/vendor/katex.min.js && cp node_modules/katex/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js static/js/vendor/auto-render.min.js && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/* static/css/vendor/fonts/
